A complete programme, delivered with universities

What Super Engineering brings

Curriculum for Board of Studies review, lab design and setup, student kits, reference designs, teaching guides, faculty training, studio engineers and links to industry.

What the university keeps

Admissions, student records, fee collection, exams, results, faculty appointments and the award of the degree stay with the university.

Ways for companies to work with students

Bring an engineering problem

Give students a clear problem and a few review hours. Teams build a prototype you can evaluate.

Review and mentor

Share an engineer’s time at design reviews. See how students use feedback and make technical choices.

Host final-semester interns

Offer 16–20 weeks of supervised engineering work and see what students can contribute to a real team.

Hire with evidence

Review candidates’ project portfolios and individual skills records alongside your usual interviews.

Support a lab or kit

Supply equipment, tools or sponsorship so students can learn with your technology.

Mentor a student team

Practising engineers and founders can review designs, judge project days or help a student team test a startup idea. The mentor network is designed to match you with projects in your field, with an expected commitment of about two hours a month.

For those who want the detail

The design uses AICTE’s 160-credit structure, includes mandatory courses and is designed around outcome-based assessment and NEP 2020 multiple entry and exit. Academic adoption, approvals and delivery arrangements rest with the university.

Private and deemed universities and autonomous colleges can explore adopting the full programme. Affiliated colleges can discuss delivering the build-based model within their university’s syllabus.

Reference designs, weekly guides, standard kits and individual test stations give partners a common way to assess what students can do. A partnership should produce work that can be shown, such as a prototype, a mentored team or a completed internship.
